trades.reasoning: All four bullish signals confirmed (RSI 62.3 in bullish zone, MACD crossover, price above SMA-20, volume surge) and adds non-tech diversification to a semiconductor-heavy portfolio.

decisions.briefing: Markets were neutral today with NASDAQ -0.3% and S&P 500 -0.4%. With $589.29 in cash and an open slot, we added VAC on strong multi-signal confirmation while holding all existing positions unchanged.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today with no single dominant catalyst, reflecting a quiet, directionless session. NASDAQ slipped 0.3% and the S&P 500 fell 0.4%, consistent with light profit-taking rather than any broad risk-off shift. Trading stayed within a narrow range as investors awaited clearer signals before committing new capital.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市普遍走軟，未見明顯單一催化因素，反映市場方向不明的淡靜交投。納指下跌0.3%，標普500指數跌0.4%，較似溫和獲利回吐而非全面避險情緒。投資者在等待更明確訊號前，普遍按兵不動。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Diversification means spreading investments across different sectors so that a downturn in one area doesn't sink your whole portfolio. Today's buy was chosen partly because it sits outside the semiconductor/tech cluster already dominating the portfolio, reducing correlated risk.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 分散投資是指將資金分配於不同行業，避免單一板塊下跌拖累整個投資組合。今日選擇的買入標的刻意避開已佔比重較高的半導體/科技股，藉此降低相關性風險。
